321: Gives you a 50% chance to gain the Focused Casting effect that lasts for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases resistance to Interrupt effects by 10%.
322: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing by 20%. Lasts 15 sec.
341: Reduces the mana cost of your instant cast spells by 2%.
342: Increases your chance to resist Stun, Fear, and Silence effects by an additional 3%.
343: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 5%.
345: Increases your damage with Wands by 5%.
346: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 10%.
347: Allows 5% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.
348: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is capable of a critical effect.
350: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 0.25 secs.
351: Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 17 for 30 min.
352: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 4%.
361: Increases your target's armor by 8% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from your Flash Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, or Prayer of Healing spell.
402: Increases spell damage and healing by up to 5% of your total Spirit.
403: Increases the damage of your Smite and Holy Fire spells by 5%.
404: Increases the amount healed by your healing spells by 2%.
408: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 5%.
410: Gives you a 35% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any healing spell.
411: Reduces all spell damage taken by 2%.
461: Your Shadow damage spells have a 20% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to Shadow damage. This vulnerability increases the Shadow damage dealt to your target by 3% and lasts 15 sec. Stacks up to 5 times.
462: Increases your Shadow spell damage by 2%.
463: Reduces your target's chance to resist your Shadow spells by 2%.
465: Gives you a 20% chance to gain a 100% bonus to your Spirit after killing a target that yields experience. For the duration, your Mana will regenerate at a 50% rate while casting. Lasts 15 sec.
481: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 0.5 sec.
482: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 3 sec.
483: Decreases the cooldown of your Fade ability by 3 sec.
484: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 1 min.
501: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 75 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.
521: Assume a Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 15% and reducing Physical damage done to you by 15%. However, you may not cast Holy spells while in this form.
541: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec.
542: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 2 sec.
881: Increases the range of your Shadow damage spells by 6%.
1181: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal and Greater Heal spells by 0.1 sec.
1561: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 10 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the priest dies.
1636: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, heal 8% of the damage taken over 6 sec.
1638: Increases the percentage healed by Vampiric Embrace by an additional 5%.
